build: Electronic Arts disk release, two double-sided disks as four G64 side images; play copies made with the game's own Copy utility

extra: tile set 5, unpacked from T35/L12 by enter_map ($2722) with map 38

comments.text: Tile 0 of tile set 5, blank as in every set. Set 5 has thirty more blank bitmaps (11-14, 24, 25, 28-30, 33, 34, 37, 38, 42, 44, 45, 50, 62, 73, 75-77, 81, 83-85, 91, 93-95), and neither of its maps uses tile 0, in the layer or off the edge (map 38 draws 64 there, map 42 draws 43). Set 5 serves maps 38 ('Entering Nuclear First Aid.', 'Entering the Center of Holy Knowledge.') and 42 (its texts name 'the Inner Sanctum'), both on side 3.

Tiles 1-6, the figures every set shares (1 grey robot-like humanoid, 2 red and orange one-eyed hulk, 3 yellow and green runner, 4 man in a cyan shirt, 5 tied sack, 6 brown horned creature); no layer of set 5 holds them. Computed from the records, every encounter square of both maps would show 4 (map 38: 30, map 42: 7); tile 5 shows on the loot-bag squares, map 38's (23, 6) and (24, 6) and six of map 42 (five in a row at x 21-29, y 1, and (1, 11)).

Tile 7, the green-shirted party figure that game $AF1D-$AF25 draws on the party's square. Set 5's layers place it once, on map 38's class-11 square (24, 28), and map 38's class-4 square (10, 4) shows it in the opening of the brown desk at x 9-10, y 3-5. The self-modified operand of draw_tile's LDA at $2367 points here, tile 7 having been drawn last.

Tile 8, the radiation sign: draw_square shows it from 18:00 to 05:59 ($0B80-$0B8A) on map 38's 16 class-9 squares, a block at x 22-25, y 8-10 (layer tiles: the lattice 51, the blocks 16, 17 and 21, the rings 60) and the four squares (16-17, 14-15) near the map's centre (wall pieces 52, 54, 55 and 57); map 42 has none.

Tile 9 of set 5, the purple peak over light blue and blue bars (the same in sets 1-4, 7 and 8), drawn by game $AD13-$AD49 for each of the player's other parties on the same map; neither layer of set 5 holds it.
Tiles 10-14 of set 5: 10 a brown and orange chair seen side-on, its back at the right (map 38: 4, at (25, 2), (6, 6), (26, 17) and (27, 19); map 42 at (9, 16)); 11-14 blank, unused by the maps.

Tiles 15-23 of set 5, orange blocks with brown edges; 15-21 are the bitmaps of sets 2 and 4. 15: 8 squares (map 38: 4, map 42: 4, mostly beside chairs); the rest all on map 38: 16 at (22, 8), 17 (5: (22, 9) and a column at (29, 26-29)), 19 (7), 20 (a column at (28, 2-6)), 21 (3); 18 unused by the maps; 22 and 23 the top and bottom of a block that straddles two squares, (23, 28) and (23, 29).

Tiles 24-30 of set 5: 26 a light blue and dark grey frame around white rungs, a white bar at its right (map 42 at (27, 5), class 8, beside the blue double door at (25-26, 4)); 27 white stripes across black, set 4's 33 (map 42: 8, a block at x 24-27, y 7-8, framed by the tiles 86, 88 and 89); 24, 25 and 28-30 blank, unused by the maps.

Tiles 31-35 of set 5: 31 a light blue door with a white knob in a blue frame (35 squares: map 38: 32, map 42: 3; 24 class 2, 9 class 1, 2 class 11); 32 a light blue upright between white bars, with red specks, unused by the maps; 33 and 34 blank, unused; 35 a light blue, white and dark grey shape with limbs reaching to its corners (map 42 at (28, 29), class 2, inside the frame at x 26-30, y 27-30).

Tiles 36-40 of set 5: 36 a chair seen side-on with its back at the left, set 2's 35 in orange (map 38: 8, map 42: 1); 37 and 38 blank, unused by the maps; 39 and 40 brown triangles under white-dotted diagonals, the slanted ends of map 38's desk at (10, 3) and (10, 5).

Tiles 41-45 of set 5: 41 green stripes across black, set 1's 64 and set 3's 14 (map 42: 30 squares at x 21-30, y 1-3, five of them loot-bag squares); 43 blue rings on white, map 42's 396 class-11 squares around its buildings and its off-map tile; 42, 44 and 45 blank, unused by the maps.

Tiles 46-50 of set 5, orange squares with a white bar along one side: 46 the bottom (map 38 at (9, 5)), 47 the right (map 38's class-4 square (10, 4), which shows the party figure 7), 48 the top ((9, 3)) and 49 the left (unused by the maps); with 39, 40 and the chair 36 at (9, 4) they make the desk at x 9-10, y 3-5 of map 38. 50 is blank, unused.

Tile 51 of set 5 (set 8's 51 too), a purple lattice of diagonal lines on black: the floor of map 38 (333 squares) and two patches of map 42 (22 squares: x 4-9, y 10-12, and x 27-29, y 28-30 around the shape 35).

Tiles 52-57 of set 5, bands of light blue, white and blue that turn a corner (52, 54, 55, 57) or run straight with a short branch (53, 56): wall pieces of maps 38 and 42 (52: 28 squares, 53: 98, 54: 32, 55: 35, 56: 113, 57: 37), class 11 but four, map 38's class-9 squares (16-17, 14-15). 52 and 53 are set 7's tiles too.

Tiles 58 and 59 of set 5, small blue and white shapes over the purple lattice: 58 with a green band (map 38: 16, fourteen of them in the rooms at x 4-12, y 8-12) and 59 in a green frame (map 38: 11, at x 5-8, y 14-19); nearly all class 11.

Tiles 60-62 of set 5: 60 brown and dark grey rings above white bars (map 38: 8, two of them class-9 squares); 61 brown bars stacked around a dark grey upright, two columns on map 38 at x 27 and 29, y 8-13 (10 squares, class 2); 62 blank, unused by the maps.

Tiles 63-66 of set 5: red dashes on black, sparse (63: 33 squares), medium (64: 56, all class 11, also the off-map tile of map 38) and dense (65: 47), the ground along the edges of map 38 and in its south at x 15-18, y 27-31; 66 grey, red and white fragments on black, in no layer but the tile of a door blown apart, which the door check squares become when an explosive passes (map 38's class-4 record 0, $3EE5, 'The door is all over the place, in little pieces.'; map 42's record 0, $3C16, for its door at (6, 13)), and of map 38's rubble, records 6-9 ($3EF1-$3EFA), which remote-change record 18 ($44A9) puts on 16 squares.

Tiles 67-77 of set 5: 67-71 and 74 more pieces of the banded light blue, white and blue walls, straight runs with branches and crossings (67: 93 squares, 68: 38, 69: 24, 70: 23, 71: 19, 74: 108, on maps 38 and 42, all class 11; 67 is set 7's too); 72 grey and white rubble, in no layer but the tile of a battered door, which the door check squares become when strength (or, on map 42, a crowbar, sledge hammer or ax) forces them: map 38's class-4 record 1 ($3EE8, 'A battered door hangs from one hinge.') and map 42's record 2 ($3C1C); 73 and 75-77 blank, unused.

Tiles 78-85 of set 5: 78 and 79 dark grey with black chevrons pointing right and down (78 on map 42's class-10 squares (11, 22) and (11, 29), the east ends of its two long halls; 79 unused by the maps); 80 white rails over a purple cross (map 38 at (1, 2), class 10); 82 a blue and dark grey checked band between white stripes, unused; 81 and 83-85 blank, unused.

Tiles 86-89 of set 5: 87 purple stripes across black, the floor of map 42's buildings (301 squares); 86 the stripes crossed by a light blue, white and blue band (7), 88 the stripes behind a blue, light blue and white upright (8) and 89 four grey blocks (6), the frames on map 42 around the white stripes at x 24-27, y 7-8 and around the shape 35 at x 26-30, y 27-30.
Tiles 90-95 of set 5: 90 solid white (every pixel pair 11), 17 class-11 squares of map 38; 92 solid blue, unused by the maps; 91 and 93-95 blank, unused.

Colour bytes of tiles 0-9 in set 5 (high nibble: pixel pairs 01, low nibble: pairs 10): the shared 0-8 ($26, $CF, $28, $57, $39/$36, $B7/$BC, $98, $59, $76), then tile 9's $46, $46, $E6, $E6 (purple, light blue, blue).

Colour bytes of tiles 10-23 in set 5: $26 then three $89 (orange, brown) for the chair 10; $26 for the blanks 11-14; $86 and $89 (orange with blue or brown) for the blocks 15-21; $26 over $86 and $89 for 22; $89 over $29 (red, brown) for 23.

Colour bytes of tiles 24-50 in set 5: $EB (light blue, dark grey) for 26 and 35; $E6 for the door 31; $E2 (light blue, red) for 32; $86 with a $26 cell for the chair 36; $98 (brown, orange) with one $26 cell each for the desk ends 39 and 40; $56 (green, blue) for the stripes 41; $66, blue for both pair values, for the rings 43; $86 for the desk sides 46-49, with an $88 cell in 46; $86, $89, $26, $26 for the blank 42; $26 for the stripes 27 and the other blanks.

Colour bytes of tiles 51-77 in set 5: $24 (red, purple) for the lattice 51; $E6 (light blue, blue) for every wall piece, 52-57, 67-71 and 74; $56 over $54 (green with blue or purple) for 58 and 59; $9B (brown, dark grey) for 60 and 61; $26 for the red ground 63-65 and the blanks; $C2 (grey, red) for 66; $CB for the rubble 72.

Colour bytes of tiles 78-95 in set 5: $2B (red, dark grey) for the chevrons 78 and 79; $B4 over $24 (dark grey, red, purple) for 80; $B6 (dark grey, blue) for the checked band 82; $E4 and $64 (light blue or blue with purple) for 86 and 88; $24 for the stripes 87; $CB for the grey blocks 89; $26 for the white 90 (its pairs 11 take colour RAM), the blue 92 and the blanks.
